scan_result: P.Oxy.XXXI2533 is a second-century papyrus scrap preserving middle portions of 15 lines. Its first editor assigned it only tentatively to the closing scene of Fabula incerta; Arnott records matching names (Chaireas and a supplemented Moschion) but explicitly retains the attribution as speculative. The 1966 publication included a plate; no explicit PDM/CC-BY current image host was verified, and Oxford's EES image service requires reproduction requests rather than granting a redistribution licence.
